caption:
OpenAI has officially closed a historical $40B funding round at a $300B valuation, announcing they now reach 500 million weekly active users on ChatGPT.

This isn't just another venture round—it marks a fundamental shift in the AI landscape. Building frontier AI towards AGI is no longer just about algorithmic breakthroughs; it requires nation-state level capital and massive energy infrastructure.

Via OpenAI Newsroom (March 2025).
